issues.detail: The guide does not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases.

scenarios.name: github-issues-list-view
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets most rubric requirements but lacks error handling with showToast, whereas Response B fails to use useFetch, getPreferenceValues, and mapResult, missing key elements.

scenarios.name: github-create-issue-form
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response A omits the TagPicker, enableMarkdown, and popToRoot, missing key elements.

scenarios.name: github-notifications-menu-bar
scenarios.rationale: Response B implements the basic menu bar and fetch logic but omits keepPreviousData, caching, and interval configuration, whereas Response A is empty.
